title: Is Renting a Bad Idea When You Can Afford to Buy?

scenes.text: A 30‑year mortgage payment of $1,200 is cheaper than rent in many cities.
If you can afford the monthly payment, buying is always better than renting.
scenes.label: Affordability Equals Ownership

scenes.text: Buying adds upfront costs—down payment, closing fees—and ties you to a fixed location. Renting offers flexibility and avoids maintenance costs that can exceed mortgage payments over time.
scenes.label: Flexibility Matters

scenes.text: Consider your job stability and future plans before buying.
scenes.label: Plan First

scenes.text: Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: Buying a home looks great on paper, but is it the right move for you? Discover why renting can sometimes be wiser. Follow for more real estate insights!
